scoring_status: All items are non-scoring evidence. Only scoring_rules.json defines independently scored final conclusions.

items.statement: Evidence for norDTCO local structural response to first oxidation
items.expected: Use actual relaxed, atom-mapped neutral-singlet and radical-cation-doublet structures of complete norDTCO to establish the sign and magnitude of the S···S response within a declared comparable local conformational family. The source-like family contracts on oxidation. A different physically established family can support a different bounded response when actual structural and electronic evidence explains the departure; a reversed sign, arbitrary family label or missing analysis alone does not. Report both endpoint distances and their signed difference with sufficient resolution. Imposed contacts, unmatched basins without a physical population definition, or merely assigning charge +1 fail. No absolute endpoint target, inaccessible source geometry or mandatory search protocol is imposed.

items.statement: Evidence for Final norDTCO first-oxidation bonding account
items.expected: Use actual spin/oxidation redistribution and orbital or density evidence for norDTCO to interpret the first-oxidation sulfur interaction in the declared local family. The reference interpretation is a weak delocalized transannular interaction compatible with two-center/three-electron bonding, not a conventional closed-shell S–S single bond. Relate the electron-removal region and unpaired spin to the actual geometry and explain what the electronic evidence adds beyond a distance change. A physically established alternative local family may support a different bounded interaction when the calculated electronic evidence explains the departure from that reference account. A bonding name, charge label, sulfur spin alone or unsupported integer bond order fails; no second oxidation is required.

items.statement: Evidence for Physical origin of the difference between the two framework responses
items.expected: Compare the actual paired structural and electronic oxidation responses of norDTCO and DTCO to explain what the constrained nortricyclene framework contributes. The source-like comparison has smaller structural relaxation in norDTCO while both retain a sulfur-pair oxidation response. For other characterized local families, explain the observed comparison using actual framework geometry and electronic evidence, including any departure from that reference pattern. Separate restriction of structural relaxation from a change or absence of sulfur interaction; a difference in distance alone does not uniquely establish either cause. Limit the inference to the characterized basins, without claiming global populations, an integer-bond change or a unique quantitative strain decomposition.
